system.name: Omni-RewardBench
system.one_liner: The first omni-modal reward-model benchmark with free-form preferences: nine tasks over text, image, video, audio and 3D, each judged under written criteria.

content.variant_note: nine pastel task cards ring a central coloured scatter cloud, each card a full query, two responses, two criteria and the preferences
content.argues: Reward modeling spans nine input-output modality pairs, and preferences are free-form: the same two responses can be ranked either way depending on the written criterion.
content.subject: Nine reward-modeling tasks, each shown with a query, two candidate responses, two free-form criteria and the preference under each, around a coloured point cloud.

new_tags.name: ring-of-cards-with-leaders
new_tags.what: task cards arranged around a central picture and tied to its clusters by dashed leader lines in each card's colour

lessons.what_to_learn: Give every task the same card template (title, query, two responses, criteria with verdict tags), tint each card in its own colour and carry that colour to a leader line and a cluster in a central cloud, so many modalities read as one family.
lessons.suits: Benchmarks or datasets spanning many modality combinations where each task needs one full worked sample and the reader should see the breadth at once.

evidence: Illustration of nine reward modeling tasks in Omni-RewardBench.
Figure 1 provides an overview of the nine tasks covered in Omni-RewardBench, spanning a wide range of modalities.

summary: Omni-Reward is a step toward generalist omni-modal reward modelling with free-form preferences, with a benchmark, a dataset and a model. Figure 1 illustrates the nine benchmark tasks. Nine pastel cards, five on the left and four on the right, ring a multicolour scatter cloud and are tied to it by colour-matched dashed leaders. Every card follows one template: a task title (Text-to-Text, Text-Audio-to-Text, Text-to-Audio, Text-to-Video, Text-Video-to-Text, Text-to-Image, Text-Image-to-Image, Text-Image-to-Text, Text-to-3D), a query Q, two candidate responses R1 and R2 as text, waveforms, film strips, images or sword renders, and two dashed free-form criteria C1 and C2, each ending in a preference tag such as R1 > R2. The text is 4.5 pt serif throughout.
summary_zh: Omni-Reward提出支持自由形式偏好的全模态奖励建模。图1展示九类任务：九张按任务着色的卡片围绕中央彩色散点云，各含问题Q、候选回答R1/R2和虚线框标准C1/C2及偏好标签。
notes: The meaning of the central scatter cloud (probably the task clusters of the data) is inferred from the colour-matched leaders; the text that cites the figure does not describe it. The Text-Video-to-Text card prints R2 > R1 under both criteria although R1 is the concrete answer; recorded as printed. Pre-screen kind scope-overview kept; the hub arrangement is a modifier, not a second kind.
